lyrics: said?         Got that look of winter
dread. Says a boat came in
Walked right by and   turned away.
Face was tight and   drawn and paper-thin,
air is still, the furnace sleeps,
Heard 'em talkin' by the gate. Something
Used a lot of   words I've never heard
But a different kind   of silence
It's a different kind   of cold...
We always thought the   river flowed one way.
We always thought we'd get our say.
But the gears are   grinding slow and
But a different kind   of silence
It's a different kind of cold...
...are we bought or are we sold?
